dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit jagged, non-uniform perimeters. The gradient transitions sharply from a dark outer base to a high-intensity, narrow light line defining the inner boundary of the shape.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low density of solid pixel clusters; high-intensity pixels are predominantly organized into thin, filament-like lines rather than solid core blobs.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the prominent posterior 'O' ring and the two adjacent central 'C' shapes form a nearly linear geometric chain along the lower-lateral axis.

other_distinctive_markers: A complex network of fine, interconnected light-colored filaments forms a marbled texture across the mid-dorsal region, bridging larger macro-annuli.
